# FastKiwi

> FastKiwi makes free Windows 10/11 apps that are fast, light, work offline, keep data on the user's PC and support Arabic and English.

## Apps
- [InstaFind](https://fastkiwi.app/arabic-file-search/en/): instant file search for Windows that understands Arabic spelling and more scripts and keyboard layouts, searches inside PDF/Word/Excel through a word index, opens with Ctrl+Alt+F; version 1.0 has a new look and 40 interface languages (Arabic, English and 38 machine-translated). Arabic page: https://fastkiwi.app/arabic-file-search/
- [Remember Me](https://fastkiwi.app/Remember-Me/): tasks, notes and reminders that stay on screen until handled; quick add from any app (Ctrl+Alt+R); 12 languages; also in Microsoft Store.
- [Lemon](https://fastkiwi.app/lemon/): offline ChatGPT-style Windows app for local Ollama models (single .exe, Arabic and English), with assistants that answer only from your files and a live HTML/JS preview. Needs Ollama. Arabic page: https://fastkiwi.app/ar/lemon/
- [InstaWords](https://fastkiwi.app/instawords/): free amount-in-words (tafqit) tool for cheques and invoices in English, Arabic and French; 100+ currencies and units, bulk/CSV mode (https://fastkiwi.app/instawords/bulk.html), works offline in the browser, as a Windows app with an English or Arabic interface (https://github.com/sarmadiq9090-coder/InstaWords/releases/latest) and in Excel (=TAFQIT(A1, "USD", , , , , "en"); https://fastkiwi.app/instawords/excel.html). Arabic page: https://fastkiwi.app/instawords/
